}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (3 [[Cookbook:Pound|lbs]]) broiler/fryer [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]], giblets removed
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Country Roast Chicken Seasoning|Country Roast Chicken Seasoning]]
* 3 sprigs [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]
* 8 sprigs [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
* 1 large [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] thinly
* 1 large lemon, cut in wedges
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]

== Procedure ==
#Loosen skin from chicken. Rub flesh with chicken seasoning.
#Place lemon slices in the bottom of a roasting pan and place chicken on top.
#Stuff chicken cavity with thyme, rosemary, and lemon wedges.
#Place 1 tbsp butter under the skin of each breast.
#Insert an oven-safe probe [[Cookbook:Thermometer|thermometer]] into the breast but not touching the butter.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in a 325°F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] until breast internal temperature reaches 165°F and thigh meat reaches 170°F.
#Cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]] and let rest 10 minutes; serve.
